id.description: ID of the canvas the project is for.

project.description: The candidate source project to validate.

canvasSdkVersion.description: Version of the host-injected `ph` canvas SDK the project targets.

dependencies.description: Exact-version dependencies, restricted to the platform-supported set (react, react-dom, @posthog/quill, recharts, lucide-react, dayjs) at their pinned versions.

entryHtml.description: The project's entry HTML file. Currently always "index.html".

files.description: Project files keyed by relative path (forward slashes, no '..'). Until the canvas build service ships, only "index.html" and "src/canvas.tsx" (the single React component the canvas mounts) are supported.
